content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

content_sections.heading: Project and Job Description
content_sections.text: The project is titled "Microseismic Wave Detection in Coal Mines Using Fiber Optic Geophones for Artificial Intelligence-Based Structural Health Monitoring". It focuses on developing fiber optic geophones that detect microseismic waves for AI-based structural health monitoring. The work involves: Designing the optical geophone in related software Collecting data Developing AI/ML algorithms for signal processing and model development FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Junior Research Fellow Vacancy Details 2026
IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Junior Research Fellow Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age and any relaxation are as per the norms of the Govt. of India. Candidates need one of the following: M. Tech. / M.E. / M.S. in Electronics Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering, Optical or Opto-Electronics M. Sc or M. Sc. Tech. in Physics / Electronics or an equivalent degree, with a minimum of first class or above from the reputed Institute In addition, candidates must have qualified the GATE/CSIR-UGC NET examination. Experience in COMSOL, Machine learning and programming (Python/MATLAB) in the relevant field. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility for this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted on merit and as per the requirement of the project. Shortlisted candidates attend an interview, which will be in online/offline mode. Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview date. Having the minimum qualification does not guarantee an invitation to the interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The tenure is 12 months, or until the completion of the project, whichever comes earlier. The position may be converted into a regular JRF of the institute at any point, subject to the IIT(ISM) rule.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the online application form . Complete and submit the form before the deadline.

faq.question: Q1. Is GATE or NET compulsory for this JRF position?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must have qualified the GATE/CSIR-UGC NET examination in addition to holding the essential degree.

faq.question: Q2. Can M.Sc. candidates apply?
faq.answer: Yes. An M. Sc or M. Sc. Tech. in Physics / Electronics or an equivalent degree is accepted, with a minimum of first class or above from the reputed Institute.

faq.question: Q3. Which skills are preferred?
faq.answer: Experience in COMSOL, Machine learning and programming in Python or MATLAB is desirable, but it is not listed as essential.

faq.question: Q4. How long will the position last?
faq.answer: It runs for 12 months, or until the project is completed if that comes earlier.

faq.question: Q5. Can this become a regular JRF position?
faq.answer: It may be converted into a regular JRF of the institute at any point, subject to the IIT(ISM) rule.

faq.question: Q6. Will travel costs for the interview be paid?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid. Candidates must also make their own arrangements for their stay at Dhanbad, if required.

faq.question: Q7. Who is the Principal Investigator of the project?
faq.answer: Dr. Amitesh Kumar, Associate Professor, Department of Electronics Engineering, IIT(ISM) Dhanbad. His printed mobile number is 09431166555.
